body: The integration test `test_soft_vs_hard_water_shrimp_survival` (molt_mineral_budget.rs:726-748) asserts only that `hard_population - soft_population >= 5` over 1000 simulated hours starting from 36 shrimp. This is an extremely weak assertion — a gap of 5 is ~14% mortality difference, while the mineral modifier for the soft profile (Ca=10, Mg=2) should produce a modifier around 0.12, causing near-certain molt failures. The test should assert a more meaningful population gap (e.g., >= 15) or assert that the soft-water population drops below a specific threshold (e.g., < 20). The adjacent seeds (9000 vs 9001) also introduce unnecessary RNG variance; consider using the same seed to isolate the mineral effect.
